announce.isekai_mahou.demon_lord.intro: Mortals in my hall? Kneel... or burn.
announce.isekai_mahou.demon_lord.meteor: The Nether sky falls upon you!
announce.isekai_mahou.demon_lord.phase1: Feel the fire that never dies!
announce.isekai_mahou.demon_lord.phase3: NO MORE PRETENDING TO BE HUMAN!
bestiary.isekai_mahou.demon_knight.desc: Black-armored guard. Its shield stops arrows from the front — flank it.
bestiary.isekai_mahou.demon_lord.desc: Master of the Demon Citadel. He starts as a swordsman and ends as a winged beast of fire.
bestiary.isekai_mahou.demon_succubus.des: A sorceress who charms and pulls her victims. Fragile up close.
Infernal Forge: weapon in main hand, catalyst in off hand (Fire Essence/Blaze Rod = Fire; Shadow Essence/Wither Rose = Shadow) and %s XP levels.
Hold a catalyst in your off hand (Fire Essence, Blaze Rod, Shadow Essence or Wither Rose).
This weapon already has that infusion.
block.isekai_mahou.demon_pact_altar.alre: You already have an active pact.
block.isekai_mahou.demon_pact_altar.debt: The pact is over. Now the altar collects: Infernal Debt.
block.isekai_mahou.demon_pact_altar.hint: Pact Altar: offer a Shadow Essence or Ghast Tear. Gain power for 5 min; pay with blood, max health, hunger — and then the Debt.
Demons recognize a Warlock: your pact lasts 8 min and the debt only 1 min.
block.isekai_mahou.demon_pact_altar.in_d: You still owe the altar. Wait for the Infernal Debt to end.
block.isekai_mahou.demon_pact_altar.seal: The pact is sealed. Power burns in your veins.
The Lord's Sigil speaks for you: a pact without debt.
The pact is sealed — demons give you Warlock terms.
boss.isekai_mahou.demon_lord.subtitle: Master of the Demon Citadel
command.isekai_mahou.nether_citadel.not_: No Demon Citadel found nearby (world made before v1.6? Only new Nether chunks have them).
command.isekai_mahou.nether_citadel.spaw: Could not summon the boss here.
command.isekai_mahou.nether_citadel.tp: Teleported to the Demon Citadel at %s %s %s.
effect.isekai_mahou.demon_debt.descripti: Weaker, slow mana, hunger. The altar refuses new pacts. Milk does not cure it.
effect.isekai_mahou.demon_pact.descripti: Damage +35%, spell power +30%, faster. Price: −3 hearts and hunger.
item.isekai_mahou.citadel_sun_katana.des: Its blade glows orange like sunrise. Demons fear it.
item.isekai_mahou.citadel_sun_katana.use: Use: Flaming Dash — rush 7 blocks, cutting and burning (7 s).
A black greatsword that came from a five-leaf grimoire.
Hits strip buffs. In hand: enemy magic deals 30% less damage.
Use: Anti-Magic Slash — destroys spells and projectiles ahead and strips buffs (5 s).
item.isekai_mahou.demon_lord_sigil.desc: His name, branded in ember. Demons still obey it.
item.isekai_mahou.demon_lord_sigil.use: Offer it at the Pact Altar: a pact with NO Infernal Debt.
journal.isekai_mahou.nether_citadel.adam: Rare hidden ore in the Nether (y 8–32, never touching air), or in citadel chests. Smelt it into ingots.
Tougher than netherite. Not required — but worth every ingot.
journal.isekai_mahou.nether_citadel.demo: Throne hall (north). 4 phases: sword, flames, imp legion (kill them: they shield him) and the Demonic Form.
He was human once. A long time ago.
journal.isekai_mahou.nether_citadel.ente: Go to the Nether and follow the journal compass. The citadel sits near lava-sea height, often carved into the rock.
The south gate has signs ordering you to kneel.
journal.isekai_mahou.nether_citadel.forg: In the courtyard (west). Weapon in hand, Fire/Shadow Essence in the other, and 5 XP levels.
journal.isekai_mahou.nether_citadel.intr: In the Nether, between rivers of lava, stands a fortress of black brick. They say a Demon Lord rules from there — and hoards Adamantite.
journal.isekai_mahou.nether_citadel.lore: Walls, a courtyard with the Infernal Forge and the Pact Altar, and a throne hall where the Lord sleeps seated, waiting for challengers.
journal.isekai_mahou.nether_citadel.outr: The throne is empty. For the first time in centuries, the citadel falls silent.
journal.isekai_mahou.nether_citadel.pact: Make a pact at the Altar
In the courtyard shrine (east). Offer a Shadow Essence or Ghast Tear. Warlocks get better terms.
message.isekai_mahou.demon_lord.imp_shie: With 2+ imps alive, the Lord takes half damage — kill the imps!
message.isekai_mahou.nether_citadel.ente: You entered the Demon Citadel. The air smells of brimstone... and gold.
tooltip.isekai_mahou.adamantite_set: Full set: immune to fire and lava.
